Dear Service Coordinator / RC,
I am writing to inform that we are moving the case
0477922
﻿from the Technical Support to the eMobility RC-FR SI E Queue. We kindly ask you to take over the case and perform the necessary troubleshooting steps.
Customer:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
MP / R8 170002510
Charger ID / Serial No.:
6oKoGF
Charger address/functional location:
Priority:
Medium
Handover reason:
This error flag can be caused by network-related issues such as:
1) A defective or disconnected network cable,
2) A faulty network switch, or
3). Power supply problems with the payment terminal.
It is also important to verify that the IP address configuration of the payment terminal is correct. For example, the payment terminal should have a static IP address, subnet mask, gateway, and DNS settings properly configured. Additionally, ensuring all connections are secure and swapping the Ethernet cable with a new one can help identify if the cable is the source of the problem. The Ethernet connection should be set up as follows: Payment terminal connected to Switch, which is then connected to Router 2  1.
If all the troubleshooting doesn´t help please proceed to replace. Let me know if you need further support in MS Teams.
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-FR SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under Documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require Expert Support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com

rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution following the case handling guidelines.
